document.text:
49 CFR 1540.111 — Carriage of weapons, explosives, and incendiaries by individuals.

(a) On an individual's person or accessible property—prohibitions. Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property—

(1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter;

(2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or

(3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.

(b) On an individual's person or accessible property—permitted carriage of a weapon. Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is one of the following:

(1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport.

(2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter.

(3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

(c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:

(1) Any loaded firearm(s).

(2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless—

(i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded;

(ii) The firearm is unloaded;

(iii) The firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and

(iv) The container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.

(3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.

(d) Ammunition. This section does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm. Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies in any of three circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property— (1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about their person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Applies if the individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized under §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is one of the following: (1) ... or (2) ... or (3) ...
unit_attributes.statement: The prohibitions in paragraph (a) do not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is on-duty airport law enforcement required to carry weapons, an individual authorized under specified federal regulations, or an individual authorized under a security program to carry a weapon in a sterile area.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: (1) Any loaded firearm(s).
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all specified conditions in (i) through (iv) are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All four conditions must be met to avoid the prohibition: (i) oral or written declaration prior to checking baggage that the bag contains an unloaded firearm; and (ii) the firearm is unloaded; and (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: ... (2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless— (i) ... and (ii) ... and (iii) ... and (iv) ...
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 unless the passenger declares the unloaded firearm orally or in writing before checking the baggage, the firearm is in fact unloaded, the firearm is in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a passenger transporting or offering for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: ... (3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23.
